meta_description: Based in Duncansville, PA. Title, leasing and due diligence across the Appalachian, Gulf Coast, Permian and Michigan basins, and the landmen who do the work.
page_subtitle: Rickey and Shannon Matherne, Certified Professional Landmen in Duncansville, Pennsylvania.
intro: Clients include operators, exploration companies, independent producers, mineral and royalty owners, and institutional investors. Engagements range from single-tract curative work to multi-county leasing programs, acquisition and divestiture (A&D) packages, and portfolio-scale due diligence.
approach:
Title work is run to the end of the chain rather than to the first clean deed. Defects frequently sit several conveyances back, in probate and heirship records filed outside the expected county or index.

Where the record is unclear, it is reported as unclear rather than resolved by assumption. Reports state what was found, what it means, and what the options are, and are written to be handed directly to counsel, a lender, or a buyer's diligence team.

The same standard applies to every project, regardless of size.

cta.headline: Work with the people who do the work.
cta.text: Have a project, or a letter about your land? Call or send a note. You'll hear back from Rickey or Shannon.
